description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open source testing management tool. It generates printable views of test cases, initializing parameters, rendering HTML headers, and outputting test case details based on user input and session data.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request parameters related to test case ID, version, project, and output format.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up GUI parameters including object name, page title, and project info based on arguments and node data.
